_note: Publications whose star ratings are shown but do not count toward the ranking. Not a judgement on the writing: it is what we can say about the rating. A publication we have seen once, awarding five stars, has told us nothing that distinguishes one show from another — its rating cannot move a board it has only ever pushed in one direction. Reviews stay on the show's page, linked and credited, because the review is real and the company earned it. Reviewed each year: a publication that goes on to review widely, using the range, belongs back in the count. Remove an entry to restore it — nothing else needs changing.
